It is bright without being harsh, with a metallic sheen and a glassy transparency. Its range is wide, handling everything from a low, full tone to a high, sharp one. Because the steel bar presses on the strings, the sound has a gliding quality and notes join smoothly, giving a continuity like singing. Compared with a conventional guitar the timbre is softer and deeper; compared with the piano it is more emotional and more expressive. The characteristic slide lets the instrument imitate the rise and fall of the human voice; the sound has many layers, folk in character and yet with the feel of a modern electronic instrument.
